description: 后牵制威胁——黑方被迫用后吃兵避免马被钉死
explanation_en: White's queen creates a pin threat. Black must use the queen to capture the pawn; if the knight captures instead, it becomes pinned and White can bring in another piece to win it.

intro.popup: 💡 牵制威胁：白后f2，黑马b6，白兵d5，黑后d8。白后进入d2可威胁d列牵制！若黑马吃兵Nxd5则被钉死。
intro.popup_en: 💡 Pin threat: White's queen is on f2, Black's knight on b6, White's pawn on d5, and Black's queen on d8. Qd2 threatens a pin on the d-file. If the knight captures with Nxd5, it will be pinned.

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Qd2制造牵制威胁！黑若Nxd5，马被后钉在d列动不了（动则丢后）。黑方只能后换后应对，白方借牵制夺得主动。
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Qd2 creates a pin threat. If Black plays Nxd5, the knight is pinned to the queen on the d-file. Black must exchange queens, allowing White to seize the initiative.

moves.popup: 白后Qd2！制造d列牵制威胁：若黑马Nxd5，马被白后钉死在d5（后在d2，马在d5，黑后在d8）。
moves.popup_en: White plays Qd2, threatening a pin on the d-file. If the knight captures on d5, it will be pinned between White's queen on d2 and Black's queen on d8.

moves.popup: 黑方用后吃兵，避免马被牵制——马吃则被后钉死。
moves.popup_en: Black's queen captures the pawn to avoid the pin. If the knight took instead, it would be pinned by the queen.

moves.popup: 白后吃回，双方换后，白方局面更好。
moves.popup_en: White's queen recaptures. After the queen exchange, White has the better position.

moves.popup: 黑马Nxd5回吃，但已没有牵制威胁，白方另有计划。
moves.popup_en: Black's knight recaptures on d5. The pin threat is gone, but White has another plan.

moves.popup: 白兵c4攻击d5上的黑马！马必须撤退，白方夺得主动。
moves.popup_en: White advances the c-pawn to attack the knight on d5. The knight must retreat, and White takes the initiative.
